description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends a base DateRangeSearchFilterParams class and provides filter parameters for searching leave entitlements based on employee numbers, leave type ID, and deletion status. It also specifies allowed sorting fields and includes getter and setter methods for its private properties.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for filtering leave entitlements based on various criteria such as employee number(s), leave type ID, and deletion status. It also manages sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'entitlement.fromDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number if set.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status filter for leave types.
